propositions: Jira Data Center self-hosted instances differ from Cloud on three axes: REST v2 with wiki-markup bodies instead of REST v3 with ADF, PAT bearer auth instead of ACLI subprocess, and name-based user identity instead of accountId, making them irreconcilable by the current Cloud-only adapter
PR #120 proposed a second forked adapter that duplicated mapping logic and reached into private symbols, creating undocumented shared-layer dependencies with no contract and no structural enforcement

The fix creates an explicit jira_family sub-seam by extracting shared value maps, sanitizers, and contracts (RichTextCodec for ADF vs wiki text, UserIdentityModel for accountId vs name) while keeping location-pinned modules (adf.py, outbound_fields.py, comment_limits.py) at their paths and reusing them via dependency inversion
The DC backend uses pycontribs/jira behind a [jira-datacenter] optional extra, gated by lazy import, so the engine's clean-core dependency contract and Cloud's battle-tested path remain unaffected

DC connections require HTTPS with certificate verification never disabled, PAT read from JIRA_PAT environment variable only (never config file), and allow_insecure override only for cleartext URLs like the test harness

Bidirectional reconciliation against Jira 8.17.1 Data Center is verified live: inbound creates/updates sync to local store, outbound edits appear on DC issues, with idempotence and no unhandled exceptions
